gbr.overview: The islands off Queensland's coast offer real walking, reached by boat or ferry. The best-known route is the Ngaro Track in the Whitsundays, with island day hikes to viewpoints over the turquoise water. The cooler months from May to October are the only sensible time to walk, as tropical heat and humidity make the rest of the year hard going.

jordan.overview: Hiking here means walking among ancient sandstone ruins and vast desert landscapes. At Petra, the steep climb up 800 rock-cut steps to the Monastery earns views over the valleys, while the back-door trail from Little Petra is a longer approach along the Jordan Trail. In Wadi Rum, guided desert walks explore towering rock formations and deep canyons. The best walking is in the mild spring and fall.

galapagos.overview: Walking in the Galápagos means short, guided excursions to volcanic landscapes and coastal viewpoints rather than independent hiking. Visitors reach the trailheads by boat and follow licensed guides at most sites, along marked paths through lava fields and highland reserves.
